login.failed: Incorrect email or password. Please check and try again.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
login.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask your company manager for a reset link.
login.noAccountHint: Designers sign up their company. Customers and field crews sign in with the account a designer created for them.

signup.slugHelp: 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. It can’t be changed after sign-up.
signup.passwordHelp: 10–72 characters. Common passwords or one repeated character aren’t allowed.
signup.noEmailVerify: There’s no email verification. Make sure you enter the email you’ll sign in with.
signup.rateLimited: Too many sign-up attempts. Try again in an hour.
signup.success: You're signed up. You can use your company space once the site admin approves it.
signup.agree: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
signup.agreeRequired: Agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy to sign up.
signup.unavailable: We couldn’t complete sign-up. If you already have an account, sign in. If this keeps happening, try again shortly.

invite.newAccount: New here? Enter your name and a password to create your account.
invite.existingAccount: Already have an account? Sign in, then accept.
invite.loggedInAs: You’re signed in as {email}. If that’s not the invited email, sign out and open the link again.
invite.accepted: Invitation accepted. Taking you to the project.
invite.createFailed: We couldn’t create an account. If you already have one, sign in and then accept.

reset.done: Password changed. You’ve been signed out on all other devices.
reset.linkInvalid: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask your company manager for a new one.

account.passwordChanged: Password changed. You’ve been signed out on your other devices.

selectArea.intro: Choose where you want to go.
selectArea.none: You’re not part of any company or project yet. If you received an invitation link, open it again.
selectArea.companyPending: Waiting for site admin approval. You'll be able to use this company space once it's approved.
selectArea.companySuspended: This company is suspended. Contact the site admin.

firstPassword.intro: You signed in with the temporary password from your email. Set the password you'll use from now on.
firstPassword.tempHint: Enter the temporary password from your email.
firstPassword.expired: Your temporary password expired. Ask the designer who created your account to resend it.
